<notes>
kept -> base harness -> all 3 rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1) delivered successfully using identical harness code; all made single LLM call and returned properly formatted answers; no repeated failures, no concrete trajectory moments showing harness defects, and no evidence supporting changes. The output variance across runs (base1: "AB, ABD, ABC" vs inv1: "A, AD, AC" vs dom1: "A, AD, ABC") reflects model sampling on identical harness, not harness issues. Both candidate decisions (inv1, dom1) independently concluded KEEP_BASE. Adding changes to a harness that already delivers successfully risks regression without supporting evidence.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
